fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name exactly as on your Aadhaar card. This will be used to verify your identity against the PM-JAY beneficiary database. Even a small spelling difference can cause rejection.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna poora naam bilkul Aadhaar card ke anusar likhein. Isse PM-JAY labhaarthi database mein aapki pahchaan verify ki jaayegi. Choti si bhi galti aveekar ka kaaran ban sakti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your current age in years. PM-JAY covers all family members regardless of age. Senior citizens and children are specially prioritized.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni vartaman aayu saal mein likhein. PM-JAY parivar ke sabhi sadasyon ko cover karti hai chahe aayu kuch bhi ho. Buzyurg aur bachche vishesh roop se praathamikta mein hain.

fields.instruction_en: Select your home state. PM-JAY provides health coverage up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals across India.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna rajya chunein. PM-JAY poore Bharat mein empanelled hospitals mein parivar ko saal mein 5 lakh rupaye tak ka swasthya coverage deti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your district name. This helps identify the nearest empanelled hospitals under PM-JAY in your area.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne zile ka naam likhein. Isse aapke naazdik PM-JAY empanelled hospitals pata karne mein madad milti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number. This is used to verify your eligibility in the SECC database and generate your PM-JAY e-card.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna 12 ank ka Aadhaar number likhein. Isse SECC database mein aapki paatrata verify karke PM-JAY e-card banaya jaata hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your ration card number if available. PM-JAY primarily covers families in SECC 2011 database and beneficiaries of RSBY. Ration card helps verify eligibility.
fields.instruction_hi: Agar ho to apna ration card number likhein. PM-JAY SECC 2011 database aur RSBY labhaarthiyon ke parivaron ko cover karti hai. Ration card paatrata verify karne mein madad karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 10-digit mobile number. Your PM-JAY e-card and hospital treatment updates will be sent to this number via SMS.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna 10 ank ka mobile number likhein. Aapka PM-JAY e-card aur aspatal ilaaj ki updates SMS se is number par bheji jaayengi.
